caption: Figure. All paired-seed outcomes of the corrected GNNDelete experiment on the fixed Cora split at 10% node deletion. Each point in A/B is one joint request/training seed; both axes show D-full minus R-point accuracy. The shaded region denotes the predeclared joint direction (Retrain > 0 and GNNDelete < 0). A shows the ten exploratory seeds (seeds 6 and 2024 coincide); B retains all five independent confirmation seeds, with reverse-direction seeds marked as crosses. C reports separate cohort means and two 97.5% two-sided t intervals per cohort, yielding Bonferroni simultaneous 95% coverage for the two primary contrasts. The confirmation fails the frozen rule: 3/5 joint directions rather than at least 4/5, and the GNNDelete interval crosses zero. The cohorts are not pooled; no result is omitted. Degree controls remain in the endpoint tables but are not part of this predeclared primary contrast.
